column1: # Full annotated per-allele frequency table for the capacity-panel floor pre-step. Stays in Claude Science.
# THIS IS A COUNTS/FREQUENCIES PRE-STEP. No capacity/engageability/HED values are present or used here.
#   Membership IDENTICAL between the two tables (676==676, symmetric difference empty).
#   IMGT/HLA release the saved tables were built from: 3.64.0 (alignments fetched 2026-04-16).
#   Allele Frequency Net Database (allelefrequencies.net); dataset = Gragert et al. 2013,
#   Human Immunology 74:1313-1320 (US NMDP / Be The Match registry; EM-estimated, IMGT/HLA 3.4.0).
#   AFND access date: 2026-07-09. 21 detailed NMDP subgroups fetched (pop_ids 3201-3223; 3203 & 3221 not NMDP).
#   CAVEAT: Gragert frequencies are EM-estimated from registry typing, much of it low/intermediate
#   resolution imputed to high resolution; 2-field frequencies for rare alleles carry more uncertainty
# FLOOR DEFINITION: floor_freq_max_across_21_subgroups = MAX allele frequency across all 21 detailed
#   NMDP subgroups (never pooled, never sample-size-weighted). Broad 5-group frequencies are NOT used
#   for the floor; they appear only in the chromosome-coverage report (quantity 4).
# COLLAPSES: AFND reports these NMDP data at 2-field resolution already; NO 4-field->2-field summing
#   was required. No catalog collapse was required.
# VERIFICATION column: 'matched_2field_direct' = allele has >=1 AFND row (see n_subgroups_observed);
#   'ABSENT_no_afnd_row' = allele has NO AFND row in any subgroup -> SEPARATE STRATUM, never dropped by a floor.
#   All 20 absent alleles classified GENUINELY ABSENT (2-field name existed at IMGT 3.4.0 but unobserved in
#   the NMDP panel); verified against IMGT/HLA Allelelist_history.txt + Deleted_alleles.txt (3.4.0 vs 3.64.0).
#   Empty per-subgroup freq cell = allele not listed in that subgroup (absent-in-panel), distinct from an observed 0.0.
